name: settlers-tribute
description: A peaceful browser economy and logistics game

scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run test:soak && npm run build:pages && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name settlers-tribute --branch main
scripts.preview:pages: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages dev dist --compatibility-date 2026-10-12
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests index.html tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests index.html tsconfig.json
